visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro: A pair of hands carefully holds a large, deep pink dragon fruit directly towards the camera. The background reveals a clean kitchen setting with a bright stove and a red cooking pot. Soft yellow and pink text overlays occupy the center and bottom of the frame. (2) Selection: The camera focuses tightly on the fruit's outer skin, showing its unique leafy protrusions and waxy texture. The hands rotate the fruit to inspect for any dark spots, while variety captions pop up to provide advice on choosing the most vibrant produce. (3) Cutting: The fruit is laid upon a white, quilted paper towel placed on a light-colored wooden cutting surface. A sharp stainless steel knife is used to slice off the ends of the fruit with precise horizontal motions. The skin is then slit vertically to the depth of the flesh. (4) Slicing: After the skin is pulled back like a blanket, the bright magenta flesh is exposed. The knife cuts the flesh into uniform, boat-shaped wedges. The hands then gently push each slice onto a nearby white plate decorated with delicate blue floral patterns. (5) Eating: The perspective shifts to a medium shot of a woman with short dark hair wearing a white shirt and a pink apron. She smiles warmly at the lens, uses a small fork to pick up a slice, takes a bite, and expresses her joy with a double thumbs-up gesture.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 不用砧板，不沾手 火龍果最佳切法 提高火龍果甜度感❤️. (2) [Slogan]: 挑選火龍果技巧! 渾圓飽滿 深紅色、有光澤. (3) [Slogan]: 選「較重」的. (4) [Slogan]: 表皮有黑點、黑斑表示有蟲害!. (5) [Slogan]: 懶的洗砧板，可以墊一張廚房紙巾. (6) [Slogan]: 頭尾切掉 像這樣水果轉一圈來切. (7) [Slogan]: 轉個方向... 繼續切除果萼端 像這樣水果轉一圈來切. (8) [Slogan]: 這樣可以避免刀子切到桌面 這樣就可以清楚看到皮跟肉. (9) [Slogan]: 皮的地方切開一刀 切到肉的深度即可. (10) [Slogan]: 利用刀肉把皮勾起來 一開始慢慢的挑，不要急 直到皮的邊緣都掀開為止. (11) [Slogan]: 歡迎留言分享 你的切法❤️ 像這樣~ 皮就掀起來了. (12) [Slogan]: 慢慢的掀~ 像是掀棉被一樣 掀到這裡即可 保留一小段，預防沾到手. (13) [Slogan]: 將水果一分為二 採用放射狀的切法 提昇火龍果的甜味. (14) [Slogan]: 刀子推一下 一片果肉就掉落到盤子啦~. (15) [Slogan]: 切成船型的樣子 這樣切法可以讓甜味「平均化」 讓每一口甜味平均分布. (16) [Slogan]: 切好放盤子 兩片果肉完美著地!. (17) [Slogan]: 讓果皮朝下 轉個方向 繼續再切. (18) [Slogan]: 果萼端切掉 果皮再拉開 繼續切.... (19) [Slogan]: 利用刀 把果肉推出來. (20) [Slogan]: 果皮丟棄... 像這樣切火龍果 超簡單輕鬆❤️✅. (21) [Slogan]: 準備個水果叉 小盤子✅ 取用自己要吃的份量. (22) [Slogan]: 不用砧板，免沾手 火龍果最佳切法 提高火龍果甜度感✅. (23) [Slogan]: 用叉子切對半 大口吃下去才好吃!❤️. (24) [Variety]: 好甜，讚喔❤️. (25) [Slogan]: 吃完不能張開口，會好可怕，哈❤️ 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Intro: Acoustic folk-pop music with a bright, rhythmic guitar strumming pattern and a steady percussion beat begins. A female voice with a friendly and clear tone introduces the kitchen hack. Her pitch is moderate and her speech rate is steady and conversational. (2) SFX: A sharp, percussive 'click' and 'slice' sound occurs as a knife cuts through fruit skin. This is followed by the crisp, high-frequency rustling of paper towels being adjusted on a hard surface. The background music remains upbeat and steady. (3) Texture: The narrator’s voice becomes more animated as she describes the ease of the process. Short, muffled thuds are heard as slices of fruit land on a ceramic plate. The ambient noise floor is very low, resembling a quiet indoor studio. (4) Climax: The speaker emits a soft, high-pitched "Mm!" of satisfaction. This is followed by an energetic exclamation "讚喔" with a sharp rising pitch contour. The background music swells slightly in volume before coming to a clean, rhythmic stop.
